patterns.usage_note: A warm, familiar yes-no question, prototypically addressed downward or to an intimate: teacher to pupil, older man to a younger person. かい takes yes/no questions; its sibling だい takes questions with an interrogative word (何・誰・どこ・いつ・どうして). Where plain 〜か is brusque and top-down, かい is affectionate — same yes/no job, opposite warmth; it is markedly old-fashioned 役割語 today, rare among young speakers, and it is not used to a superior.

examples.ruby: その大[おお]きな荷物[にもつ]、一人[ひとり]で運[はこ]べるかい。
examples.english: That big load — can you carry it on your own?

examples.ruby: 新[あたら]しい仕事[しごと]にはもう慣[な]れたかい。
examples.english: So, have you settled into the new job yet?

examples.ruby: この写真[しゃしん]に写[うつ]っている人[ひと]は君[きみ]の弟[おとうと]かい。
examples.english: Is the person in this photo your little brother?
